data.name: Pain Surge
data.description: You must have suffered hit point damage within a number of rounds equal to the number of points in your wild surge in order to wild surge.  Penalties for making a concentration check for being injured while manifesting a power are lessened.  Psychic enervation: sickened until the end of your next turn and lose %1 pp.|PainPPLoss
